cues: At that moment Hooker puts it all together.
He looks at Evans twitching on the ground, at the blue clad body through the trees, and he thinks of the little dashes on the map.
The dashes marked poisoned thorns, like those the Dyaks of Borneo use in blowpipes, planted all round the treasure.
That is what Chang-hi meant by very safe.
And he understands that grin now.
